name: NCAA D-I Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Ames, IA · host Iowa State · Iowa State Cross Country Course
headline: NCAA D-I Midwest Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 25 Iowa State won the women’s race with 72 points over No. 8 Oklahoma State (91), with Betty Kipkore and Rosemary Longisa second and third behind Oklahoma State’s Billah Jepkirui (19:18.9). No. 3 Oklahoma State won the men’s title 57 to 61 over No. 10 Iowa State behind a 1-2 from Brian Musau (28:47.1) and Denis Kipngetich (28:50.0).
